join.title: Watch the game
join.hint: Scan the QR code at the entrance or type the match code.
join.notfound: No match with that code. Check the code on the sheet or screen.
join.offline: Can't reach the hub. Are you on the rink's Wi-Fi?
join.refer: Want to run this for your own team?
cam.title: Camera
cam.setup: Set the phone up steady, ideally on a clamp at the glass, then tap Start.
cam.label: Where are you?
cam.denied: Camera is blocked. Allow the camera in your browser settings and reload.
cam.insecure: Open the camera page via the https address on the hub, otherwise the phone won't release the camera.
cam.keepon: Keep the screen on and the phone on a charger.
view.nocams: No cameras are streaming yet. Ask someone at the rink to tap Start camera.
view.noevents: No events yet. Tap Highlight when something happens.
lobby.title: Hub
lobby.nocams: No cameras have joined yet. Show the QR code to whoever is filming.
lobby.admin: Open the admin view on a tablet
update.nudge: A new version of the hub is available.
update.blocked: The hub must be updated before it can be used.
cal.title: Calibrate the camera
cal.hint: Tap a point on the rink drawing, then the same point in the camera image. At least four points, spread across the whole image.
cal.good: Calibrated. The lines should sit on the ice markings.
cal.rough: Saved, but the error is large. Add more points far apart.
lobby.teams.hint: Jersey colours are grouped automatically. Tap the group that is the home team.
lobby.teams.waiting: Collecting jersey colours… starts once players are on the ice.
view.rink.empty: No players tracked yet. Cameras need calibrating on the hub.
view.players.empty: Stats appear once tracking has run for a while.
view.clips.empty: No clips yet. Clips are cut from the tags when the game ends.
roster.title: Team roster
roster.hint: Add names and numbers. Tap a dot on the rink to link it to a player. Opted-out players get no name, stats or clips.
roster.name: Name
lobby.external: Add the rink camera or another source
lobby.external.label: Name, e.g. Rink camera
lobby.external.hint: RTSP/RTMP/HTTP address of the arena camera, or a capture device. It is calibrated and tracked like a phone.
